turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How's the phone ordering voice assistant been received by customers?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Order accuracy is up and hold times are down since we launched it — genuinely one of the better ROI projects we've run this year.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Any customer pushback on talking to an AI?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Surprisingly little. A few older customers ask to be transferred to a human, and we made sure that's a one-word request away, which has kept complaints minimal.
